title: Inuvias Brightlance
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Inuvias Brightlance | image = Inuvias Brightlance.png | level = 40 | type = Elite | faction = Neutral | aggro = [[Alliance|Alliance]] [[Horde|Horde]] | race = Night elf | creature = Humanoid | gender = Male | location = [[Vilethorn Scar]], [[Crescent Grove|the Crescent Grove]] | status = Active }} '''Inuvias Brightlance''' is a [[night elf]] [[ghost]] located in [[Crescent Grove|the Crescent Grove]]. ==Quotes== ;Gossip The world has changed a lot, and it seems so very different from when I left it. Something lingers within the air, but I cannot see it, there is something amiss, but my thoughts are muddled, and almost lost to themselves. I can see you though, you are in a place that I once called home, that many of my people called home, lost to the ages of time. I don't know why I am here again, but you will aid me. ==Trivia== * Despite being a ghost, Inuvias is classified as a humanoid. ==Patch changes== * [[File:Expansion_logo_mysteriesofazeroth.png|40px]] '''[[Patch 1.16.0]] (2021-12-27):''' Added.
